pages: For the people...?

There are lots of women who are just pretty,

pages: Well then, I'm off.

pages: Take care of Father and Mother for me.

pages: Sister... I understand. For everyone...
So that everyone can be happy...

but thanks to Lord Hattori Hanzo the Shogun escaped,
and set up a temporary shogunate in Nikko.
jp: 吽号とか申す化け物に 壊滅させられましたが / 服部半蔵様のご活躍で 将軍様は落ち延び / 日光に仮の幕府を 立てておりました

pages: Well, no matter. Given the circumstances,
a little rest now and then won't hurt...

pages: Right away...

pages: Scream!

pages: ...I'm listening.

pages: That's right!

pages: Now I shall devour your soul,

pages: Kukuku... Begging for your life now?
So the Yagyu sword has finally shown its true colors.
jp: ククク・・・今さら命乞いか？ / 柳生の剣、とうとう馬脚を 現したというわけだな

context.ru: Хм-м... очень дорогое на вид кольцо.

pages: ...My, my. I should have chosen better whom to show mercy.
jp: ・・・やれやれ、情けも相手を見て かけるべきじゃったのう

context.ru: Хм-м... очень дорогое на вид кольцо.

pages: Kukuku... Only embers of your life remain.
I hope it lasts until you reach Edo...
jp: ククク・・・ 貴様の命の残り火もあとわずか / 江戸にたどり着くまで もてばよいが・・・

context.ru: Хм-м... очень дорогое на вид кольцо.

pages: Tremble in fear!
With every step you take, your candle of life
grows shorter, inch by inch...
jp: 恐怖しろ！ / 貴様が一歩を踏み出すたびに 命のろうそく、一寸刻みに / 短くなって・・・

pages: Ow!
jp: あたっ！

pages: J-Jubei! You! Watch where you're going!
Can't you even follow the rules of the road?!
jp: じ・・・十兵衛ッ 貴様ッ、気をつけろ！ / 交通ルールも守れんのか、貴様は！

pages: Wh-what's this?! Y-you wanna fight?!
jp: な、なんだなんだ！ や、やるのか！

pages: All right, bring it on! Behold! My ultimate secret art... Hm?
jp: ようし、望むところだ！ 見よ！　究極奥義・・・ん？

pages: Wh-what? Humans...?
jp: な・・・なんだぁ？ 人間どもが・・・？

pages: You'd be... Yagyu Jubei, right...
jp: 柳生・・・ 十兵衛さんだねぇ・・・

pages: Hm... I am.
jp: ム・・・いかにも

pages: Word was you were dead,
but turns out you were alive all along...
jp: あんたは死んだってことに なってたらしいけど / 実は生きてたんだってね・・・

pages: Thing is, there's folks who don't do so well if you're alive...
...that's how it is, see.
jp: なんかさぁ、あんたが生きてたら 良い思いができないお人がいる / ・・・みたいなんだな、これが

pages: Assassins hired by the Osaka faction?
Or Mori? ...Shimazu, perhaps?
jp: 大阪方にやとわれた刺客かな？ / それとも毛利？・・・島津か？

pages: Come on, that doesn't matter, you know that.
You've made enemies... of everybody.
jp: そんなこたあ、あんた 意味ないじゃん、分かったって / あんた、恨まれてんだよね ・・・みんなに

pages: Heh... Fair point.
Indeed, there are too many to count on both hands.
jp: ふふん・・・理屈じゃの / 確かに思い当たる筋が多すぎて 両手の指でも数え切れんわい

pages: You're a smart one after all.
jp: やっぱあんた、頭良いわ

pages: Then you get that it's about time you died, right?
jp: んじゃ、そろそろ死に時だってのも 分かるよな？

pages: Heh heh heh... Time for YOU to die!
jp: フフフ・・・そなたのな！

pages: Prepare yourself, Jubei!
jp: 十兵衛、覚悟ォ！

pages: Your life is mine!
jp: お命ちょうだいっ！

pages: Jubei belongs to me, the great Ongokuki...
jp: 十兵衛はこの御獄鬼さまが・・・

pages: Ow ow! What're you doing?! Hey!
jp: いてて！ なにすんだ！　おい！

pages: Gwaaah!
jp: ぐわぁぁぁ！

pages: Guoh!
jp: ぐぉっ！

pages: Now then... Perhaps I'll ask your name.
jp: さて・・・ 名でも聞いておこうかのう

pages: You're not as good as the rumors say, Yagyu Jubei.
...Were you busy plucking nose hairs?
jp: 噂ほどではないな、柳生十兵衛 / ・・・ハナ毛でも 抜いておったのか？

pages: Heh heh heh... Then let your body test the truth of the rumors.
jp: ふふふ・・・では噂の真実 お手前の体で確かめてもらおう

pages: Kukuku... A small fry like you after Jubei's life?
Small as you are, I admire your spirit!
jp: ククク・・・雑魚の分際で 十兵衛の命を狙うとは / 小物ながら 見上げた心意気だのう！

pages: You've been noisy for a while now...
What're you supposed to be?
jp: さっきから うるさいやつじゃな・・・ / 何だぁ？　貴様？

pages: Here, he is no match for you.
Stand back, stand back!
jp: これ、お主にかなう 相手ではないぞ / 下がれ、下がっておれ！

pages: Your soul, though not as fine as Jubei's,
looks rather tasty...
Be honored to be killed by the great Ongokuki!
jp: 貴様の魂 十兵衛ほどではないにしろ / なかなか美味そうではある・・・ / この御獄鬼様に殺されることを 名誉に思え！

pages: Final secret art! Vacuum Rending Elemental Destruc...
jp: 最終奥義！ 真空裂破素壊・・・・

pages: Hmph... Filthy demon scum...
jp: ふん・・・ 薄汚い魔物風情が・・・

pages: ...There was no need to kill him.
jp: ・・・何も殺すことは ないであろう

pages: Nonsense... The weak die.
Humans and demons alike.
jp: たわごとを・・・ 弱いやつは死ぬ / 人間も魔物も同じことよ

pages: The weak die... I see.
jp: 弱いやつは死ぬ・・・か なるほどのう

pages: And now you die too!
jp: そして貴様も死ねぃ！

pages: Im... impossible... So fast...
jp: ば・・・ばかな・・・ 速い・・・

pages: ...Needless killing debases the soul.
You think you hone your skill, but in truth you lower your worth as a man.
jp: ・・・無益な殺生は魂を卑しめる / 技を磨いているようで、その実は 人としての器量を堕としめる

pages: In the end, you may beat the weak, but never overcome the strong...
You can never surpass your limits and keep growing.
jp: 結果、弱きには勝てども 強きには克てぬ・・・ / 自らの限界を超えてそれ以上 どこまでも成長することはできん

pages: Not understanding that, you are a mere assassin,
and it was your fate to be cut down here.
jp: それが分からぬお主は しょせん一介の刺客止まり / ここで斬り果てるが運命だったのよ

pages: Ugh... I regret...
Strangely, I couldn't hate that fellow.
Do demons have something like life, just as men do?
jp: 不思議に憎めぬ やつじゃったのう / 魔物にも人と同じ 生命らしきものがあるのか・・・

pages: Perhaps devouring souls is, unexpectedly,
an expression of a wish to draw closer
to us who walk the true path of life.
jp: 魂を喰らうというのも、存外 / 生命の正道を歩むわしらに 近づきたいという想いの / 現れなのかも知れぬ

pages: ...Thinking so, I pity him.
jp: ・・・そう思うと哀れじゃが

pages: Might I ask one favor of you...
jp: 一つ、頼まれてくれぬか・・・
